details.completeness_justification: All HIGH criteria are represented at least in core meaning. K2 is only PARTIALLY_PRESENT because the candidate omits the explicit mention of newly consolidated agriculture assets (Estonia Farmid and Halinga) as a distinct driver of revenue/EBITDA growth, although the acquisition itself is noted later.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: revenue and EBITDA growth are explained by the Tallink consolidation and energy-segment improvement (S2–S4), the drop in net profit is explicitly attributed to non-recurring 2024 one-off items (S6–S7), and the balance-sheet changes are presented in a consistent sequence (S8–S11). Segment descriptions (S14–S19) are clearly separated by business area and do not contradict any consolidated figures. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational problems, or unnecessary repetitions are present.
